scripts.dev: npm run -w packages/types dev & npm run -w apps/api dev & npm run -w apps/web dev
scripts.build: npm run -w packages/types build && npm run -w apps/api build && npm run -w apps/web build
scripts.start: npm run -w apps/api start & npm run -w apps/web start
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w packages/types typecheck && npm run -w apps/api typecheck && npm run -w apps/web typecheck
